key_point: Splatoon's first heroes were blocks of tofu
title: Splatoon's first heroes were blocks of tofu
caption: Splatoon's first prototype starred blocks of tofu shooting ink. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #splatoon #nintendo

instagram.caption:
Nintendo has revealed that Splatoon's first prototype had no characters, just white tofu-like blocks shooting black and white ink.

The team then looked for a creature that would make sense hiding in ink. Rabbits were tried before the idea of squids clicked.

Squids could shoot ink, swim in it and hide in it, and the Inklings were born.

Team squid or team octo?
